title: Lester rejoins in 1933 after the Blue Devils break up
summary: Phillips says Lester came to King Oliver about a year after Phillips, in 1933, on tenor, after the Blue Devils broke up, having been in Minneapolis in 1932.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving

blocks.x: Okay, I misunderstood. How did Lester Young get back in the picture? How did Prez get back into playing with you?
When he came to King Oliver.
What month was that?
Must have been something like about May or something like that in...
So you'd already been with him about a month or so...
No. I'd been with King Oliver for about a
Phillips - 101
year. This was after the Blue Devils band broke up.
This was around May of '32?
No. When Les came back? That was '33. He didn't come back until a year... I'd been with King Oliver about a year or more before he came back.
What was Lester playing at that time?
Tenor. He had been with the Blue Devils! The Blue Devils band broke up.
Yeah, with Walter Page's Blue Devils.
Yeah. But it broke up. Page had left them, though. Leroy White had them then. Walter Page had gone with Basie [SIC: Bennie Moten]
Did Lester get the clarinet yet at that time? Or was he just playing tenor saxophone?
He was just playing tenor.
So he was back there in May of '33. He joined King Oliver.
Yeah.
I misunderstood. I'd thought he joined that band in '32, but he says '33.
He wasn't with us then. I think Les was in Minneapolis at that time, in '32, playing with Hines, a piano player named Hines -- Frank Hines.
